title: Fisher-KPP wave of advance of an advantageous gene

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Fisher-KPP wave of advance of an advantageous gene

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: An advantageous allele spreading through a continuous population advances as a travelling wave whose speed is set by the selection coefficient and the diffusion (dispersal) rate.

fields.label: Notation
fields.value: u_t = D u_{xx} + s u(1-u); travelling waves u(x-ct) exist iff c \ge c^* = 2\sqrt{sD}; compactly supported initial data spread at asymptotic speed c^*

fields.label: Work
fields.value: The wave of advance of advantageous genes

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: The wave of advance of advantageous genes (1937)

fields.label: Source as written
fields.value: Ronald A. Fisher (1937) The wave of advance of advantageous genes

fields.label: Agent
fields.value: Cursor agent (Claude Opus 5.5) extracting key claims from source papers

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: one spatial dimension (extended to R^n), constant diffusion D, logistic (genic) selection with coefficient s, deterministic large-population limit

fields.label: Formal status in the nanopub
fields.value: proved; Kolmogorov, Petrovsky and Piskunov (1937) gave the proof independently, and Aronson and Weinberger (1978) proved the asymptotic spreading speed in several dimensions. Finite populations, Allee effects or long-tailed dispersal change the speed.

fields.label: Notation
fields.value: u_t = D u_{xx} + s u(1-u); travelling waves u(x-ct) exist iff c \ge c^* = 2\sqrt{sD}; compactly supported initial data spread at asymptotic speed c^*

fields.label: Proposed test
fields.value: Measure the front speed of a beneficial allele, or of an expanding population, in an experimental range expansion (e.g. bacteria on agar or laboratory insect arenas) with independently measured s and D, and compare it with 2*sqrt(sD).
